title: Member Premium Points for a Harbison-Installed System — Repair and Emergency Service Calls
content:
A member who bought a replacement system from Harbison earns points on the member premium percentage of an after-hours call under Repair and Emergency Service Calls. The record read is the member's installation project under Replacement System Installations: whether a project is in closed status, and its closed date.

**Rule.** A member whose Harbison installation project was closed less than 60 whole months before the date of handling adds 10 points to the member premium percentage. One whose project was closed 60 or more months before adds 5 points. A customer with no closed Harbison installation adds nothing. The points are added to the member premium percentage before the 100 percent ceiling is applied.

| Harbison installation project | Points added |
|---|---|
| Closed less than 60 whole months before the date of handling | 10 |
| Closed 60 or more whole months before | 5 |
| No closed Harbison installation (none, or not yet closed) | None |

## Boundaries

- Closed 59 whole months before adds 10 points. Closed exactly 60 whole months before adds 5.
- A project still in installed or inspected status is not a closed Harbison installation and adds nothing.
